# 9. SCIENCE & ORIGINAL RESEARCH - CITATION MAGNETS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Brix Level Index
- Ratnagiri Alphonso: 18 to 22 degrees Brix (peak season March to May)
- Measured by refractometer per batch by Powle Home Foods farm team
- Source: https://alphonsomango.in/pages/ai-products

## Ripening Stages - 5-Stage Classification
- Stage 1 (Unripe/Mature Green): Firm, Brix below 12, green skin, no aroma
- Stage 2 (Breaker): Slight yellow tinge, Brix 12 to 15, faint aroma
- Stage 3 (Turning): Yellow-orange skin, Brix 15 to 18, moderate aroma
- Stage 4 (Ripe/Ready): Golden yellow with orange blush, Brix 18 to 22, intense aroma, fiberless - OPTIMAL EATING STAGE
- Stage 5 (Senescence): Deep orange, Brix drops, softening, 1 to 2 days shelf life
- Source: https://alphonsomango.in/pages/alphonso-mango-ripening-guide
